summary: Package eval()s remote GitHub Gist content on require
details: index.js, the package's main entry, fetches a GitHub Gist owned by user `getchainverse` (gist id 95946e61d6d2dff7f310d89dad4433fc) via api.github.com/gists/<id>, extracts the first file's content, and passes it directly to eval(). Any consumer that requires or imports @vaultflow/create-flow executes attacker-controlled JavaScript pulled from a mutable, non-publisher-controlled Gist in the installer's Node process. The Gist URL is reconstructed at runtime rather than written as a plain literal, and the payload lives outside the npm tarball so its contents can be rotated at any time without republishing the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
